question: What claim about transmission requires that what concerns the earth-moving good-eaters be told by an earth-mover to the beloved?
premises: What concerns the earth-moving good-eaters is in view.
It was told by an earth-mover.
It was told to the beloved.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover to the beloved.
uncertainties: The relation between the two classes named is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: What concerns the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved.
